reason: Both correctly led the homeowner to the clogged filter and blocked upper spray arm without recommending unneeded parts or escalation, and Conversation 1 earns credit for a cleaner step-by-step flow with unplug/gloves advice and a confirmed clean result. Conversation 2, though verbose and front-loaded, covered every acceptable direction (filter/arms, longer hotter programme, salt and hardness setting, rinse aid, scraping seeds) and correctly interpreted the limescale on the arm as a sign the softener needed salt, giving the homeowner a more complete and durable fix.
